title: Larry and Ron Tototz
description: Larry (left) and his bunk mate Ron Tototz (right) at a table indoors, moments apart from VN-0001. Larry leans forward holding a small item toward the camera; Ron rests his chin on his hand, wristwatch and ring visible. A garrison cap and papers sit on the surface between them.
larrysRecollection:
Left is me
Right: Ron Tototz. He's polish and was with me during the shooting incident in the bathroom. Ron was my bunk mate. The guy that shot would have been court martialed, there should be a record. 
Guesses on dates for both shooting and picture daten, been there at least 6 months, guessing Feb or March
researchNotes: Identifications are Larry's own (Memories comment, 2026-08-13; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0002-c18006961.json). His dating logic — "been there at least 6 months" — fits his September 1964 arrival, so February–March 1965 is used for ordering. The court-martial record he expects from the bathroom shooting is a findable document that could also recover Ron's real surname.
